product_from_film: Synthetic Sciences presents SynSci as a workspace for AI research agents that plan experiments, run model training, write reports and help deploy a model feedback loop.
explains_well: The protein-model request stays visible through planning, training logs, a results table and a written report, giving the research promise several concrete artifacts.
unclear: The deployment section shows API documentation and a feedback diagram, but no actual request, returned prediction and new feedback-triggered training run.
scenario: Two founders demonstrate a protein-mutation model project, then expand it into deployment and ongoing retraining.
product_clear_basis: After the general co-scientist description, the visible research prompt at 16s asks to fine-tune ESM-2 for protein-mutation effects.
